evidence.quote: economic and financial conditions have improved much more than many had expected in the spring
we still face a shortfall in employment relative to its level before the onset of the pandemic.
And, of course, significant uncertainties remain, including the fact that forbearance for federally backed mortgages is set to expire in the first quarter of next year.
Today I am going to focus on the strains in mortgage markets.

parsed.rationale: The speech is mainly about financial stability and the regulation of nonbank mortgage companies, with only retrospective description of monetary policy and no forward signal.
